notes: Invented people and companies, written by sol pbc for the verona week. Nobody here is a real person. The world continues the fictional Verona cast in the solstone journal's test fixture.

juliet_capulet.name: Juliet Capulet
juliet_capulet.role: Head of product at Capulet Industries; owner of this journal

romeo_montague.name: Romeo Montague
romeo_montague.role: Staff engineer at Montague Tech; Juliet's counterpart on Schema Bridge

tybalt_capulet.name: Tybalt Capulet
tybalt_capulet.role: Engineering lead at Capulet Industries; sceptical of depending on Montague's Mesh Routing

nurse_angela.name: Angela Nurse
nurse_angela.role: Operations and release manager at Capulet Industries; goes by Angela

benvolio_montague.name: Benvolio Montague
benvolio_montague.role: Product manager at Montague Tech; keeps the peace

mercutio_escalus.name: Mercutio Escalus
mercutio_escalus.role: Designer at Montague Tech; quick and funny

friar_lawrence.name: Lawrence Friar
friar_lawrence.role: Partner at Verona Ventures; Juliet's advisor and Capulet's lead investor; everyone calls him Friar

paris_duke.name: Paris Duke
paris_duke.role: VP operations at Ducal Freight; the first customer for Schema Bridge

balthasar_davi.name: Balthasar Davi
balthasar_davi.role: Contract QA engineer on the Balcony App beta

companies.capulet_industries: Capulet Industries, maker of the Balcony App (field-inspection app for warehouses)
companies.montague_tech: Montague Tech, maker of Mesh Routing (a routing service for device fleets)
companies.verona_ventures: Verona Ventures, a small venture firm; investor in Capulet
companies.ducal_freight: Ducal Freight, a regional freight company; prospective customer

projects.schema_bridge: Schema Bridge: a shared data format and sync bridge so Balcony App inspections can flow into Montague's Mesh Routing. A joint Capulet-Montague project; Ducal Freight is the pilot customer.
projects.balcony_app: Balcony App 3.0: Capulet's mobile release; beta in progress this week, go/no-go on Friday.
projects.mesh_routing: Mesh Routing: Montague's routing service. Tybalt worries about depending on it.

deliberate_ambiguity: 'Paris' is both the person Paris Duke and the city: Juliet has a trade-show trip to Paris on the 26th. Two different things share a name on purpose.
style: Ordinary, plausible product work. Calm, friendly, a little funny. No feud melodrama, no Shakespeare quotes or verse, at most one light nod per day. Speech sounds spoken: short turns, contractions, the odd 'um' or restart, people interrupting politely. American English. No real companies, products, people or places other than ordinary city names.
